Title: Public preview: Azure Container Apps built-in authentication Microsoft Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps, a service for building and deploying modern applications and microservices using serverless containers, now supports built-in authentication. When enabled, end users can sign in to their container apps by writing little or no code using use one or more configured identity providers. Supported identity providers include Azure Active Directory, GitHub, and Twitter. You can also integrate with any identity provider that supports OpenID Connect.

This feature is currently in public preview.

To learn more, visit: https://aka.ms/container-apps/authentication.
